title: Boss Talk with Ben Horowitz
summary: I'm DOS, and this episode is Boss Talk, with A16Z co-founder Ben Horowitz and Databricks CEO, Olly Goadzee, all about leadership and management. Their conversation originally took place on social audio app Clubhouse, where they host a live chat every Tuesday at 5 p.m. You can find more of their and other conversations on our separate feed, A16C live.

thesis: The episode introduces Ben Horowitz and Olly Goadzee to discuss leadership, management, Conway's Law, and organizational transitions. The conversation also covers the Iranian Revolution, the Iran-Iraq war, and the family's escape from Tehran.
